name: Rank-Two Ample-Class Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite set family whose 1-inclusion graph is viewed as a partial cube.
statement: Ampleness together with VC dimension at most two is equivalent to avoidance of $Q_3$ and $C_6$ as pc-minors.
proof: Excluding $Q_3$ is exactly the VC-dimension-two bound. Within that class, Proposition 5 of the cited source identifies ampleness with exclusion of the remaining obstruction $C_6=Q_3^{--}$.
